title.narrative: Maximizing efforts to control and eliminate Malaria in Somalia - Somalia (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Somalia, Malaria, United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF)This program has the following goals: Attain zero malaria death and reduce malaria incidence to at least 0.5/1000 population by 2025.. Somalia Health System capacity for evidence generation, Supply managements and Community engaments strengthened. The objectives of this program are: By 2025, 100% of population at risk of malaria is provided with appropriate malaria prevention and case management services. By 2025, at least 25 districts shall be reporting zero local transmission of malaria”.. 2025, malaria M&E, EPR and surveillance capacity is enhanced to provide the required national strategic information for decision making”. By 2025, the enabling environment and systems for malaria response in Somalia are optimally functioning
